node.title: KoalaBear Q6 u2 complete-source conic exclusion
node.closure: divisor saturation plus exact orbit-profile exclusion
node.statement: In the proved KoalaBear equality-wall source reduction, every actual irreducible Q=6,s=6,u=2 conic-image component is impossible. Twelve nonzero source quartics divide the degree-24 complete source form B; the degree-two source pencil forces their divisor sum to equal 2 div(B). Conic invariance then excludes the reciprocal, D4, and D5 profiles. This closes only the conic structural branch: it supplies no owner, distinct-slope count, cap 68, row payment, or endpoint movement.
